text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This year's annual summer camp has begun, and Yaeno Muteki makes it clear she's eager to achieve her goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Mejiro Ardan and Sakura Chiyono O are even more fired up than usual. This is shaping up to be a productive summer camp.
